basic_info.description: Discover the allure of this light-filled corner home at 1688 Pine Street, Unit W707, featuring beautiful hardwood floors and an inviting open floor plan. This residence ensures excellent privacy between two spacious bedrooms. The kitchen is equipped with Studio Becker cabinets, Caesarstone counters, and a Bosch gas cooktop. Enjoy the ensuite master bath with double-vanity sinks, Caesarstone counters, and a walk-in shower. Step out onto your private deck, benefit from an in-unit washer/dryer, and take advantage of deeded parking with an electric car charger. The Rockwell offers a luxurious amenity package, including 24/7 Front Desk, Fitness Center, Bike Room, owner's Club Lounge with Media Room, Courtyard with BBQ Grill and a penthouse-level Sky Lounge with an outdoor terrace showcasing stunning Russian Hill views and fire pits. Conveniently located next to Whole Foods and near tech shuttle stops, this property provides unparalleled access to city conveniences.
